prompt_mode: HF tokenizer chat template; repeated text throughput fixture; EOS disabled for fixed128-token measurement

weight_inventory.basis: Local device padded tensor shape; BFP4/8 tile bytes576/1088, BF16 two bytes, FP32/int32 four bytes. Excludes allocator bank padding, shared workspaces and request/cache/trace buffers.

gate_up.reason: Accepted stage05 separate DRAM-sharded prefill projections plus packed decode/one-row projection; same BF4/LoFi policy, measured latency selection retained.

norm.reason: Full norm weights for replicated small-batch decode and hidden-sharded norm weights for prefill/nativeRS batches; no per-request conversion.

request_buffers.basis: Persistent request buffers allocated before capture. Tile-padded masks are included; cache and shared workspace are separate; common sampler static buffers are included.

preparation_memory.basis: DRAM allocator checkpoints, not a peak measurement

allocation_audit.scope: all64layer request reset, eager prefill, all-active/masked decode and common sampler plus output collector allocation events; not device timing
allocation_audit.basis: C++ graph buffer_allocate/deallocate events; actual aligned_size_per_bank times DRAM bank count. Add maximum simultaneous new allocations to pre-audit allocator baseline. Trace replay reuses capture storage; eager decode bounds its scratch. No timings from this diagnostic enter performance.

trace_allocation.basis: Allocator delta immediately before/after releasing every live trace, after all benchmark/audit work. No model/request tensors are released.
